people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When any man has a discharge from his body, because of his discharge he is unclean.
translations.bsb: “Say to the Israelites, ‘When any man has a bodily discharge, the discharge is unclean.
translations.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh, because of his issue he is unclean.
translations.asv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath an issue out of his flesh, because of his issue he is unclean.
